stories.headline: Iran Re-Closes Strait of Hormuz as US-Iran Ceasefire Teeters Before Wednesday Deadline

key_facts.fact: Iran's IRGC announced the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until the US stops blockading Iranian ports, just hours after briefly reopening it.
key_facts.excerpt: IRGC says the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until the US stops blockading Iranian ports.

key_facts.fact: Two IRGC vessels opened fire on cargo ships in the Strait of Hormuz, 23 miles north-east of Oman, without warning crews, according to UK Maritime Trade Operations Centre.
key_facts.excerpt: Two Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) vessels opened fire on the ships 23 miles north-east of Oman, without warning their crews, according to the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations Centre.

key_facts.fact: Trump declared Iran committed a 'serious violation' of the ceasefire but said a deal 'will happen one way or another, the nice way or the hard way.'
key_facts.excerpt: US President Trump says Iran has committed a 'serious violation' of the ceasefire but a peace deal 'will happen one way or another, the nice way or the hard way'.

key_facts.fact: Iran's Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf said Iran was 'victorious in the field' and only accepted the ceasefire because its demands were met. The two-week ceasefire is set to end Wednesday.
key_facts.excerpt: 'We were victorious in the field,' Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said in a national televised address, adding the United States had not achieved its goals and Iran controlled the strategic Strait of Hormuz.

key_facts.fact: Iran's chief negotiator said progress has been made but the two sides are still a long way from a deal; no date has been set for further talks.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran and the US have made progress in negotiations but are still a long way from a deal, according to Iran's chief negotiator – amplifying concerns about a possible return to war when their ceasefire expires on Wednesday.

key_facts.fact: Oil hit $100 per barrel for the first time in four years; gas prices in Southern California have risen to $6 per gallon due to Hormuz disruptions.
key_facts.excerpt: 'The price of oil already hit 100 U.S. dollars a barrel for the first time in four years,' Hacegaba said, adding that prices in Southern California have hovered near that level. 'We're seeing gas prices rise to 6 U.S. dollars a gallon.'

stories.headline: US Treasury Extends Russian Oil Sanctions Waiver Until May 16, Drawing Bipartisan Backlash

key_facts.fact: The US Treasury Department issued General License 134B on April 17, allowing transactions for Russian oil and petroleum products loaded on vessels as of April 17 to continue through May 16, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: The waiver, released late Friday, allows transactions for Russian oil and petroleum products loaded on vessels as of April 17, 2026, to continue through May 16, 2026.

key_facts.fact: Leading Senate Democrats including Chuck Schumer and Elizabeth Warren described the sanctions relief as 'shameful,' calling it a '180-degree reversal' on Kremlin sanctions.
key_facts.excerpt: Leading Senate Democrats, including Chuck Schumer and Elizabeth Warren, described the reversal as 'shameful,' particularly as it followed Russia's largest aerial bombardment of Ukraine in 2025.

key_facts.fact: Ukrainian Ambassador Stefanishyna called on the US to reinstate sanctions, warning that 'Russia must not be allowed to profit from the actions of its ally Iran.'
key_facts.excerpt: 'Russia must not be allowed to profit from the actions of its ally Iran,' she wrote, noting that the Russian representative has already characterized the recent US policy shift as 'cooperation.'

key_facts.fact: The waiver extension came days after the US had signaled it would not renew, and followed Russia's largest aerial bombardment of Ukraine in 2025 with over 40 rockets and nearly 700 drones.
key_facts.excerpt: This move has triggered a diplomatic and domestic backlash.

key_facts.fact: A similar waiver for Iranian oil was set to expire on April 19, 2026, adding to the diplomatic tension.
key_facts.excerpt: The diplomatic tension is further heightened by a similar waiver for Iranian oil set to expire on April 19, 2026.

stories.headline: Blue Origin Launches New Glenn With Reused Booster for First Time, Delivering AST SpaceMobile Satellite

key_facts.fact: Blue Origin launched its third New Glenn rocket (NG-3) on April 19 from Cape Canaveral, marking the first time an orbital-class booster was reused by the company.
key_facts.excerpt: Blue Origin plans to launch its third New Glenn rocket from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station shortly before dawn on Sunday, carrying AST SpaceMobile's BlueBird 7 satellite into low Earth orbit.

key_facts.fact: The booster 'Never Tell Me the Odds' previously launched in November 2025 and was the first New Glenn booster successfully recovered on the landing platform 'Jacklyn.'
key_facts.excerpt: The booster, 'Never Tell Me the Odds', previously launched in November 2025 and successfully touched down on the company's ocean-going landing platform, 'Jacklyn'.

key_facts.fact: Blue Origin replaced all seven BE-4 engines for this first reuse flight and added some upgrades including a thermal protection system on one engine nozzle.
key_facts.excerpt: 'With our first refurbished booster we elected to replace all seven engines and test out a few upgrades including a thermal protection system on one of the engine nozzles,' Limp wrote.

key_facts.fact: The mission carried AST SpaceMobile's BlueBird 7 satellite, the second Block 2 satellite in its direct-to-cellphone broadband constellation, featuring a 2,400-square-foot antenna array.
key_facts.excerpt: BlueBird 7 represents the second satellite in AST SpaceMobile's Block 2 constellation, intended to provide internet coverage directly to mobile devices.

key_facts.fact: AST SpaceMobile said it remains on track to deploy 45 to 60 satellites by end of 2026, expecting New Glenn boosters to be reused every 30 days.
key_facts.excerpt: 'We remain on track to achieve our target of deploying 45 to 60 satellites into low Earth orbit by the end of this year,' AST Spacemobile's Chairman and CEO Abel Avellan said.

key_facts.fact: Blue Origin is designing its boosters to support up to 25 flights each. New Glenn stands 321 feet tall, comparable to NASA's SLS.
key_facts.excerpt: Blue Origin said it's designing its boosters to support up to 25 flights each.

stories.headline: Kelp DAO Suffers $292M Exploit in 2026's Largest DeFi Hack, Triggering Cascading Market Freezes

key_facts.fact: An attacker drained 116,500 rsETH tokens (~$292 million) from Kelp DAO's LayerZero-powered cross-chain bridge at 17:35 UTC on April 18, making it 2026's largest DeFi exploit.
key_facts.excerpt: At 17:35 UTC on April 18, an attacker walked away with 116,500 rsETH, roughly $292 million and about 18% of the token's entire circulating supply in a single transaction targeting Kelp's LayerZero-powered cross-chain bridge.

key_facts.fact: The attacker forged a cross-chain message tricking LayerZero's EndpointV2 into releasing rsETH from the bridge's escrow contract, exploiting a single-verifier security configuration.
key_facts.excerpt: The forgery worked because the adapter's security stack was configured to accept the attestation of a single verifier.

key_facts.fact: Stolen rsETH was deposited as collateral on Aave V3, Compound V3, and Euler to borrow ~74,000 ETH (~$236 million), turning a bridge hack into cascading bad debt across DeFi.
key_facts.excerpt: Within minutes of the drain, the stolen rsETH was deposited as collateral on Aave V3, Compound V3, and Euler across Ethereum and Arbitrum. Against that collateral, the attacker borrowed roughly 74,000 ETH.

key_facts.fact: Kelp's emergency multisig paused contracts 46 minutes after the initial breach, blocking two subsequent drain attempts totaling ~$100 million in rsETH.
key_facts.excerpt: Kelp's emergency multi-signature wallet administrators activated protocol-wide contract pauses. Two subsequent extraction attempts targeting an additional 40,000 rsETH — approximately $100 million in value — were successfully prevented.

key_facts.fact: Nine or more DeFi protocols including Aave, SparkLend, and Fluid implemented emergency freezes on rsETH markets. Ethena suspended its LayerZero OFT bridge as a precaution.
key_facts.excerpt: Nine or more DeFi platforms implemented emergency freezes on rsETH markets, including major protocols like Aave, SparkLend, and Fluid.

key_facts.fact: The compromised bridge held reserves backing wrapped rsETH across 20+ Layer-2 chains. Kelp DAO had over $1 billion in TVL before the attack.
key_facts.excerpt: Kelp DAO, one of the largest liquid restaking protocols in the EigenLayer ecosystem with over $1 billion in TVL before Saturday.

stories.headline: 2026 Breakthrough Prizes Awarded for CRISPR Sickle Cell Cure, Gene Therapy for Blindness, and Muon Physics

key_facts.fact: The Breakthrough Prize Foundation awarded six $3 million prizes on April 18 in Life Sciences, Fundamental Physics, and Mathematics, totaling $18.75 million in prize money.
key_facts.excerpt: This year, six Breakthrough Prizes of $3 million each were awarded. This year's prize money totals $18.75 million, bringing the amount conferred over the 15 years of the Breakthrough Prize to more than $340 million.

key_facts.fact: Stuart Orkin (Harvard) and Swee Lay Thein (NIH) shared a Life Sciences prize for research that led to Casgevy, the first FDA-approved CRISPR-based gene therapy for sickle cell disease and beta-thalassemia.
key_facts.excerpt: Their research transformed the devastating blood disorders sickle cell disease and beta-thalassemia from incurable to treatable conditions through gene editing therapy.

key_facts.fact: Jean Bennett, Katherine High, and Albert Maguire won a Life Sciences prize for developing a gene therapy for inherited retinal degeneration — the first FDA-approved gene therapy for a genetic disease.
key_facts.excerpt: For developing a therapy for inherited retinal degeneration that became the first FDA-approved gene therapy for a genetic disease.

key_facts.fact: Rosa Rademakers and Bryan Traynor won a Life Sciences prize for identifying a key genetic cause of ALS and frontotemporal dementia.
key_facts.excerpt: Identified a key genetic cause of two more – ALS and frontotemporal dementia.

key_facts.fact: The Fundamental Physics prize went to Muon g-2 collaborations at CERN, Brookhaven National Laboratory, and Fermilab for precision measurement of the muon's magnetic moment.
key_facts.excerpt: Breakthrough Prize in Fundamental Physics Awarded to Muon g-2 Collaborations at CERN, Brookhaven National Laboratory, and Fermilab.

key_facts.fact: David J. Gross received a Special Breakthrough Prize in Fundamental Physics as a pioneer of the theory of the strong nuclear force. Frank Merle won the Mathematics prize.
key_facts.excerpt: Special Breakthrough Prize in Fundamental Physics Awarded to David J. Gross. Breakthrough Prize in Mathematics Awarded to Frank Merle.

stories.headline: Trump Signs Executive Order to Accelerate Psychedelic Drug Research, Provides $50M for Ibogaine Studies

key_facts.fact: Trump signed an executive order on April 18 directing federal agencies to speed up reviews of psychedelic drugs including ibogaine, LSD, MDMA (ecstasy), and psilocybin for therapeutic use.
key_facts.excerpt: President Trump on Saturday signed an executive order seeking to hasten research into the therapeutic benefits of LSD, Ecstasy, psilocybin and other mind-altering drugs by ordering federal agencies to ease restrictions.

key_facts.fact: The order provides $50 million for state-level research into ibogaine, a powerful psychedelic from a Central African shrub being studied for opioid use disorder treatment.
key_facts.excerpt: The measure also provides $50 million for state-level research into ibogaine, a powerful psychedelic made from the root of a Central African shrub that has been drawing interest from researchers for its potential to treat opioid use disorder.

key_facts.fact: The funding will most immediately benefit Texas, which already committed $50 million to studying ibogaine but recently failed to secure matching funds from a private developer.
key_facts.excerpt: The funding will most immediately benefit Texas, which has already committed $50 million to studying ibogaine but recently failed to secure matching funds from a private drug developer.

key_facts.fact: The executive order directs coordinated federal action to streamline regulatory pathways and expand cross-agency collaboration for psychedelic medicines to address the mental health crisis.
key_facts.excerpt: The Executive Order directs coordinated federal action to prioritize mental health therapies, streamline regulatory pathways, and expand cross-agency collaboration.

key_facts.fact: Biotech company Definium Therapeutics, developing LSD-based treatments (DT120 lysergide tartrate) for generalized anxiety and major depression, praised the order.
key_facts.excerpt: We are advancing a comprehensive clinical development program for DT120 (lysergide tartrate) for millions of patients living with conditions including generalized anxiety disorder (GAD) and major depressive disorder (MDD).

stories.headline: Global DRAM Shortage to Persist Until 2027 as AI Demand Outpaces Supply, Smartphone Costs Surge

key_facts.fact: DRAM production from Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron will meet only about 60% of global demand through 2027, despite billions in new fab investments.
key_facts.excerpt: A shortage of memory chips appears likely to continue until around 2027, with the top U.S. and South Korean suppliers raising DRAM production at a pace that will meet only about 60% of demand.

key_facts.fact: Memory is projected to hit ~40% of low-end smartphone manufacturing costs by mid-2026, up from 20% previously, due to chipmakers prioritizing high-margin AI memory.
key_facts.excerpt: Memory to hit ~40% of low-end smartphone manufacturing costs by mid-2026, up from 20% now.

key_facts.fact: India's smartphone shipments fell 3% YoY in Q1 2026 to a six-year low, driven by AI-induced memory cost pressures and average price hikes exceeding ₹1,500.
key_facts.excerpt: India's smartphone shipments fell by 3% year-on-year in the January-March period of the calendar year 2026 – marking the weakest quarter in six years – driven by artificial intelligence (AI)-induced cost pressures and device price hikes.

key_facts.fact: Counterpoint Research expects smartphone memory prices to increase 80-85% sequentially in Q2 2026, with India's smartphone market declining 10% for the full year.
key_facts.excerpt: More than 80 smartphone models witnessed an average price hike of 15% in the March quarter of this year, with a further 15%-20% rise expected in Q2 2026, driven by sustained cost pressures, particularly in memory, where prices are projected to increase by 80%-85% sequentially.

key_facts.fact: Generative AI models require up to 10x more DRAM than traditional servers, and cloud providers are hoarding memory modules, leaving fewer for consumer markets.
key_facts.excerpt: Generative AI models require up to 10 times more DRAM than traditional servers. Enterprise AI workloads now consume terabytes of memory per system, overwhelming current fabrication capacity.

key_facts.fact: Micron's next-generation HBM4 memory chips are sold out through end of 2026, with the company able to fulfill only 50-66% of demand from its largest customers.
key_facts.excerpt: Its next-generation HBM4 memory chips are sold out through the end of 2026. Industry data indicates the company can currently fulfill only 50 to 66 percent of demand from its largest customers.
